patches.name: Delay screen-off zoom-out
patches.description: Delays the AOD zoom-out on screen-off so the device's closing animation can finish first. The delay is configurable (default 500 ms).

options.title: Zoom-out delay (ms)
options.description: How long to wait before the AOD zoom-out starts when the screen turns off.

patches.name: Earth Super Wallpaper (AOSP)
patches.description: Makes the official Earth Super Wallpaper work on non-MIUI Android: removes MIUI framework crashes, fixes ambient-mode and weather settings, adds the five desk positions, restores the unlock animation, and keeps picker applies stable.
